description: This file defines a Flutter widget class 'CurrentConditionsCard' that displays current weather conditions including icon, city name, temperature, condition, and high/low temperatures. It utilizes external models for weather data and references a custom 'FocusableCard' widget.

classes.name: CurrentConditionsCard
classes.description: A stateless Flutter widget that presents weather condition data in a styled card with focus and press interactions.

methods.name: _iconFromName
methods.description: Maps a string icon name to a corresponding Flutter IconData.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the weather condition card, including icon, city, temperature, condition, and temperature ranges.
